item.title: 50 Cent Tells Mayor Mamdani to Focus on Taylor Swift Wedding Instead of Him: ‘We Don’t Have Beef’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trends and news. Today, we're talking about a interesting exchange between New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and rapper 50 Cent.
[Short music transition]
Host: It all started when Mayor Mamdani told Complex that he'd invite 50 Cent to a dinner party at Gracie Mansion to discuss tax policy. He even mentioned that despite their differences, he's a fan of 50 Cent's music, citing "Get Rich or Die Tryin'" as one of his all-time favorites. However, he acknowledged that their disagreement over tax policy is likely to continue, with the mayor wanting to increase taxes on the wealthy and 50 Cent opposing the idea.
[Short music transition]
Host: 50 Cent responded on Instagram, telling the mayor to focus on the upcoming wedding of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce at Madison Square Garden instead of on him. He clarified that he doesn't have a beef with the mayor, but rather disagrees with some of his ideas, particularly when it comes to taxes.
[Short music transition]
Host: This isn't the first time 50 Cent has spoken out against Mayor Mamdani's "tax the rich" policies. He's been vocal about his displeasure since the mayor's campaign began, even offering him a first-class ticket to leave the city at one point.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll be back with more updates on the latest trends and news.
